THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR HEARING, THIS DAY,
 THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT
This is an appeal filed by the claimant aggrieved by the award passed in M.V.C.No.1112/2009, dated 02.06.2012 on the file of the Principal Senior Civil Judge & Additional MACT at Hassan.

entities.text: Principal Senior Civil Judge & Additional MACT at Hassan
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The claim petition was filed seeking compensation of an amount of Rs.5,00,000/-, for the injuries suffered by the claimant in the accident.
The court below had awarded an amount of Rs.69,592/-.According to the claimant

as per Exhibit-P4 the claimant had sustained NC:
2023:KHC:37586 fracture of scaphoid bone, under the head of pain and sufferings the court below had granted an amount of Rs.15,000/-, towards medical expenses though it was claimed that the claimant had spent an amount of Rs.11,212/- the court below had granted an amount of Rs.6,872/-,

towards special diet, nursing and extra nourishment the court below had granted an amount of Rs.3,000/-, towards loss of earning during laid up period though it was claimed that he was earning a sum of Rs.10,000/- as there was no evidence, considering the income at Rs.3,000/- court below had granted for one month an amount of Rs.3,000/-.

Then compensation towards loss of future earning as the Doctor had opined that the claimant had sustained 20% disability to the particular limb and considering 1/3rd of it as 6% to the whole-body and applying the appropriate multiplier 17 i.e., 3,000 x 12 x 17 x 6/100 had granted an amount of Rs.36,720/- and towards loss of amenities an amount of Rs.5,000/- was granted.
Altogether an amount of Rs.69,592/- which was rounded off to Rs.70,000/-.

Learned counsel for the claimant submits NC: 2023:KHC:37586 that for the injuries sustained by the claimant and for the hospitalization and for the pain and sufferings the amount that was granted by the Tribunal was not reasonable.

Learned counsel submits that under the head 'loss of earning' and for the 'loss of future earning' the court below had taken income as Rs.3,000/-
which is on lower side.
3. Learned counsel for the insurance company submits that the court below basing on the evidence available on record had granted the compensation.

It is submitted that in respect of the income the claimant had not produced anything and as such the Court rightly had taken income at Rs.3,000/-
per month.
He submits that the compensation that was granted is reasonable compensation and no ground are made out for enhancement of compensation.

2 4.
Having heard the learned counsel on either side perused the entire material on record, the claimant had sustained fracture of scaphoid bone.

Considering the pain and sufferings the claimant had undergone this Court is NC: 2023:KHC:37586 inclined to grant an amount of Rs.20,000/- and towards medical expenses the court below had granted Rs.6,872/-, towards special diet, nursing and extra nourishment the court below had granted only an amount of Rs.3,000/-.
Considering the injuries and the recovery period this Court is inclined to grant an amount of Rs.10,000/- under these three heads.

Loss of earning during the laid up period is concerned court below had granted Rs.3,000/-, applying the ratio laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Ramachandrappa Vs. Manager Royal Sundaram Alliance1 this Court is inclined to an amount of Rs.4,500/- hence amount of Rs.4,500/- is awarded for loss of income during laid up period, towards loss of future earning due to disability Rs.4,500 x 12 x 17 x 6/100 = Rs.55,080/- is awarded, towards loss of amenities considering the evidence this Court is inclined to grant an amount of Rs.10,000/-.
